item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be occasional showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China tomorrow. Showers will be heavy over parts of the territory. Meanwhile, an easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually tomorrow night, and strengthen slightly over the weekend. It will be windier with a few showers over the region. Temperatures will fall slightly. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate early next week. There will still be a few showers over the coastal areas.
